REVIEW ORDER CORRECTION: J2 review returned INDETERMINATE with NO LLM spend — 'ticket not claimable yet: blocked by unclosed ticket(s) acb2' (J1). This is rebar's enforced dependency ordering (AGENTS.md: review-plan fast-fails on a not-yet-claimable ticket). Same will apply to J3/J4 (blocked by J2), J6 (blocked by J4+J5), J7, J8.
So the tree can ONLY be worked strictly serially, each ticket reviewed after its prerequisites CLOSE: epic -> J1 -> J2 -> {J3,J4} -> (J5 anytime) -> J6 -> J7 -> J8. Reviewing children ahead of time is not possible by design.
Also confirmed the parent-first cascade: claiming J1 (already certified at 2281280d) is REFUSED while the epic is open, because the cascade pulls the open epic into progress and re-runs the EPIC's gate — which my J7/J8 edits had staled. Hence the epic must be re-reviewed regardless.
All child descriptions are now FINAL (last change: J3 aligned with J2's codec rework — the codec J2 injects into the relocated _sanitize_description is the same RichTextCodec J3 formalizes; either landing order works, with a Callable[[str],str] placeholder if J2 lands first). Re-running the epic review as the LAST review before the claim; no further child text edits until the epic is claimed.
